note: T8, Swords on the Show-and-Tell'd Atraxa with A at 9 holding Force of Will + 3 blue pitch cards: A passed (Swords gave +7, Atraxa ETB still found Aluren/Petal/Brainstorm). Forcing keeps a 7/7 lifelink blocker but spends the only Force; that Force later countered Erode on Acererak and won. Worth confirming as the principle: save Force for Acererak's trigger vs white removal.

T4: Lotus Petal spent to cast Stock Up while Ancient Tomb was in hand (Boseiju played as the land). Tomb + Hedge Maze casts Stock Up and keeps Petal for a combo turn, but costs 2 life vs Boros and is Wasteland bait. Which resource matters more vs aggro?

T10: chose Lost Mine for the Aluren/Acererak loop with library 35 vs opponent 36 life (each lap drains 1 then draws 1): it won with exactly 0 cards left. Alternatives if short: stop with a card left and win with ~35 Goblins next turn, or finish via Tomb of Annihilation rooms (Trapped Entry 1 + Veils of Fear 2 vs an empty hand, no draws).

T9: Boros attacked with all 5 (A 16 -> 7) keeping only Savannah open for Erode, knowing A held Aluren. B's report calls this a mistake; reviewer thinks all-in was right since blockers do nothing vs a drain loop. Confirm for the Boros brief.
